recap.title: Rest well for the Body
items: Sleep is God's gift, not laziness
Even God rested on the seventh day
Your body needs pit stops — take them

scenes.point: Sleep isn't laziness — it's God's gift to those He loves

Jesus slept through the storm — rest is a form of trust
